Cell-Type Composition, Densities and Declared State Fractions of a Section

Source: R/analysis-cells.R
SummarizeCellComposition.Rd

Counts cells per registered type, expresses them as fractions of all cells and as densities per unit area, and adds declared subset fractions such as "marker-positive cells among cells of some types". Fractions are computed from exact counts with SummarizeGroupedCountFractions().

Usage

SummarizeCellComposition(
  cells,
  type,
  levels,
  area = NULL,
  area_divisor = 1,
  fractions = NULL,
  percent = TRUE,
  prefix = c(fraction = "fraction|", density = "density|"),
  totals = c(cells = "cells", area = "area")
)

Arguments

cells

Cell table (one section).

type

Cell-type column; every value must be in levels.

levels

Character vector: the complete type registry (zero counts are reported).

area

Optional column summed over all cells into the section area; adds density rows.

area_divisor

Divisor applied to the summed area.

fractions

Optional named list of subset fractions. Each element is a list with numerator (types), denominator (types) and optional flag (name of a logical or 0/1 column that numerator cells must have set).

percent

Express fractions in percent.

prefix

Named character vector with prefixes of the fraction and density endpoint names (followed by the type).

totals

Named character vector: endpoint names of the cells and area totals.

Value

A data frame with endpoint, measure ("fraction", "density", "subset_fraction" or "total"), type (for per-type rows), numerator, denominator and value.

Examples

cells <- data.frame(type = c("t", "t", "a", "b", "t"), pos = c(1, 0, 0, 1, 1),
                    area = c(10, 12, 9, 11, 8))
SummarizeCellComposition(cells, "type", c("t", "a", "b", "c"), area = "area",
  fractions = list("pos % t" = list(numerator = "t", denominator = "t",
                                    flag = "pos")))
#>      endpoint         measure type numerator denominator    value
#> 1  fraction|t        fraction    t         3           5 60.00000
#> 2  fraction|a        fraction    a         1           5 20.00000
#> 3  fraction|b        fraction    b         1           5 20.00000
#> 4  fraction|c        fraction    c         0           5  0.00000
#> 5     pos % t subset_fraction <NA>         2           3 66.66667
#> 6   density|t         density    t         3          50  0.06000
#> 7   density|a         density    a         1          50  0.02000
#> 8   density|b         density    b         1          50  0.02000
#> 9   density|c         density    c         0          50  0.00000
#> 10      cells           total <NA>         5          NA  5.00000
#> 11       area           total <NA>        NA          NA 50.00000
